correctness.rationale: A complete reduction from chord-parallel supporting half-planes to four members of a finite angular grid is proved. Each of 3060 direction quadruples is evaluated by exact cubic-field algebra, with rational root isolation for sign decisions; 1548 bounded candidates are feasible, the minimum cubic coefficient is (5/4,-1/2,2) and precisely nine configurations attain it. The independent shoelace consistency check agrees. Finite exhaustion applies because all chord directions have been classified; no extrapolation or continuous unrestricted optimization is claimed.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact case of the newly proposed chord quadrilateral conjecture: regular nine-gons are the first higher nontrivial odd-degree instance after the established pentagon and the reported heptagon. The full constant and all nine optimizers are classified, and the exact optimum provably uses a vertex-contact support line, improving the best edge-only arrangement. This specific geometric shift supplies an actionable benchmark for understanding the conjectured enclosing-area bound; no general theorem or publication-scale application is asserted.
